applicability.scope: Source-grounded TorchNPU operation and diagnosis; qualify the selected installed stack independently.
applicability.prerequisites: Compatible Linux, PyTorch, TorchNPU, CANN, driver and authorized Ascend device access for device execution.
applicability.input_contract: Exact stack identities, bounded workload, tensor metadata and intended correctness/measurement boundary.
applicability.produced_artifact: A source-supported procedure or diagnostic trace with actual pass/fail/not-run observations.
applicability.failure_modes: Confusing registration with device readiness, CPU fallback with NPU execution, or source inspection with runtime proof.
applicability.refusal_point: Withhold backend correctness/performance conclusions when required device/runtime evidence is missing.
applicability.hardware: Ascend NPU required for device, stream, graph, precision, profiling and HCCL checks.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; installed API and NPU/CANN execution were not validated.
BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND: Linux Ascend NPU/CANN stack, multi-rank HCCL and optional compiler runtime checks remain unavailable.
No model quality, benchmark gain, service/E2E claim or candidate promotion follows from static checks.
